problems: Blind guess ('umbrella with a crooked handle') does not match the Cut Kite. The figure reads as a kite with a long zigzag tail and a dangling string, not an umbrella or cane.

The pale blue 'silhouette' is a near-parallel trace of the gold polyline, offset by a few pixels, so it reads as a copy of the gold lines rather than an independent outline. Around the kite body and tail it doubles back on itself, which looks like a rendering artifact.
Kite body is a thin sliver: left wingtip (140,150), top point (287,112) and belly (273,168) form a narrow triangle with no diamond or spine, so it doesn't read clearly as a kite.

Labels collide: 'tail, turning down' overlaps 'tail, sweep to the left', 'tail, first bend' and 'tail, lower curve' stack on top of each other near (245-265, 320-330), and 'tail, lower bend' overlaps the tail line near (110-130, 460-470). Left wingtip and belly labels are struck through by the gold lines.
Two unlabeled white dots near (387,390) and (377,410) sit off the figure. They are not in the key list and may read as stray stars.
Orientation is correct: kite at top, tail hanging down and to the left, cut string drifting up and right from the top point.
